name: Halting Deadlift
instructions: Set up for a conventional deadlift and pull the bar off the floor.
Stop the pull at knee height and pause for 1-2 seconds.
Lower the bar back to the floor with control.
Reset and repeat. Builds starting strength and positional control off the floor.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: Halting Deadlift is an advanced hip-hinge exercise targeting the glutes, performed with a barbell. The hinge is the foundation of safe lifting — it teaches you to load the hips, not the spine.
